title: Ores API route map
description: Language-neutral RPC/HTTP contract: an object whose keys name operations and whose values are routes. This is the interchange format. Languages may *author* the same keys as method annotations, param types, return types, function types, or a combination; they serialize to this map. Close to OpenAPI operationId→path, Connect method→POST path, and OpenRPC method names — not a perfect instance of any one of those.

service.description: Process or crate that owns these routes (pmap-api-server, pmap-web-server).

propertyNames.description: Operation key. PascalCase implies Connect JSON unary POST /{service}/{Key}.

files.description: Optional extra 1:1 key→source file. Not required. Leptos/Dioxus can use Next-style path correspondence; HTTP still allows many verbs in one file.

path_params.description: JSON Schema object whose properties are RFC 6570 / OpenAPI path placeholders. Property names must equal the {vars} in path.

query_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) object for typed query-string parameters. Property names are query keys.

request_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) object for the JSON request body / RPC payload. Param types in source should match this.

response_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) object for the success payload. Return types in source should match this.

error_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) object for a documented error payload.

alias_of.description: Another map key this route aliases (REST alias of a Connect method).

transports.description: Wires that carry this key. The JSON call/receipt frame is the same on each; HTTP uses path+method, WebSocket and TCP send the frame. Omit to infer (HTTP, or WebSocket when path is /ws).

tcp_framing.description: TCP byte framing when transports includes tcp. NDJSON is one JSON object per line (same as ai-agent-bridge). Not a git dependency on that service.
